name: care-instructions
title: Care instructions
description: Garment care as a row of drawn symbols, each with its meaning in words: wash, bleach, tumble dry, dry, iron and professional care.
docs: care is an object of settings: wash ("95", "60", "50", "40", "30", "hand", "no"), bleach, tumbleDry, dry, iron and dryClean. Leave one out, or pass a value that is not known, and it is skipped, never drawn as something close; with nothing to show it renders nothing. layout="row" puts the words under each symbol, layout="list" beside it. showLabels={false} gives a row of bare symbols that are focusable and say their instruction in a tooltip and to a screen reader. labels replaces the words by key, for example { "wash-30": "Wasmachine, max 30 degrees" }.
